agent.description: Configuration settings for the Cofide Agent.

env.description: Environment variables passed to the Cofide Agent container.

AGENT_PROFILE.description: Agent profile to run under, e.g. 'kubernetes'.

AGENT_TOKEN.description: Token used by the agent to authenticate with Cofide Connect.

CLUSTER_ID.description: Identifier of the Kubernetes cluster the agent is running in.

COFIDE_CONNECT_MTLS_GRPC_TARGET.description: gRPC target for Cofide Connect's mTLS endpoint, used for API calls after registration.

COFIDE_CONNECT_MTLS_SERVER_NAME.description: Optional SNI override to use when calling Cofide Connect's mTLS endpoint.

COFIDE_CONNECT_SPIFFE_ID.description: SPIFFE ID of Cofide Connect, used for both the mTLS and xDS connections.

COFIDE_CONNECT_TLS_GRPC_TARGET.description: gRPC target for Cofide Connect's plain TLS endpoint, used when this agent registers the trust zone.

COFIDE_CONNECT_TLS_SERVER_NAME.description: Optional SNI override to use when calling Cofide Connect's plain TLS endpoint.

COFIDE_CONNECT_TRUST_DOMAIN.description: DEPRECATED: use COFIDE_CONNECT_SPIFFE_ID instead. SPIFFE trust domain of Cofide Connect.

COFIDE_CONNECT_URL.description: DEPRECATED: use COFIDE_CONNECT_MTLS_GRPC_TARGET instead. URL of Cofide Connect.

COFIDE_CONNECT_XDS_GRPC_TARGET.description: gRPC target for Cofide Connect's xDS server, used to fetch federated services config.

COFIDE_CONNECT_XDS_SERVER_NAME.description: Optional SNI override to use when calling Cofide Connect's xDS server.

MANAGEMENT_ZONE.description: Whether this agent is running in the management zone.

OIDC_ENDPOINT_ENABLED.description: Whether the agent's OIDC discovery endpoint is enabled.

TRUST_DOMAIN.description: SPIFFE trust domain this agent belongs to.

TRUST_ZONE_ID.description: Identifier of the trust zone this agent belongs to.

xdsServer.description: Configuration for the Agent's xDS server.

service.description: Kubernetes Service exposing the Agent's xDS server.

enabled.description: Whether to create a Service for the xDS server.

port.description: Port the xDS Service listens on.

targetPort.description: Target port on the pod. Defaults to port when unset.

protocol.description: Service port protocol. Defaults to TCP.

portName.description: Name of the Service port. Defaults to 'grpc-xds'.

replicaCount.description: Number of replicas for the Agent deployment.

tag.description: Image tag. Defaults to the chart's appVersion when empty.

fullnameOverride.description: Override for the fully-qualified app name.

create.description: Whether to create a service account.

automount.description: Whether to automount the service account token.

annotations.description: Annotations to add to the service account.

name.description: Name of the service account to use. If empty and create is true, a name is generated using the fullname template.

podAnnotations.description: Annotations to add to the pod.

podLabels.description: Labels to add to the pod.

resources.description: CPU/memory resource requests and limits for the container.

volumes.description: Additional volumes to mount into the pod.

volumeMounts.description: Additional volume mounts for the container.
